criteria.evidence: Replay reply: 'Pins lifted to `pinned: PinnedRef[]` with `togglePin`/`clearPins`' in the store; idea-board lifted (diff truncated, relied on model report).
PinnedRef has id, title, lane, nullable image_url/source_url; stickers pin with null URL and 'one pin path for stickers and future Lane B tiles alike' — snake_case naming deviation was disclosed.
'Rail fixed to the foot, borderless… label `N pins · conditioning input`; 48px thumbs' (turn 0 reply).
Rail has one Generate button with idle/generating/error states described.
'hidden at zero pins' and `--pin-rail-space` is 0px with no pins.
'enters on `workspace-enter`'; no new dependency reported, pnpm build cached without lockfile change.
api.py adds POST /v1/generate with GenerateRequest/GenerateResponse StrictModel contracts (session_id, transcript, pins; image_url, prompt, model, reference_count).

SynthesisedPrompt is `prompt: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=900)` plus `subject`; no validator enforces the under-80-word limit, so an overlong prompt is not a validation error (only the instructions text asks for <80 words).
fal arguments are `{"prompt": prompt}` (+ image_urls); transcript only enters `_synthesis_input`.
Headers include 'X-Fal-Store-IO': '0'; `_submit` then `_poll` against queue.fal.run; docstring 'No webhook'.
`fal_poll_timeout_seconds` default 45.0; GenerationTimedOut → `_generation_refusal(payload, "timeout")` typed status.
'Deliberately not retried, at any status' in `_submit`, plus X-Fal-No-Retry header.
OpenAI(api_key, timeout=timeout, max_retries=0) with wait_for; httpx.Timeout(connect/read/write/pool) on the fal client.
`import httpx`, no fal SDK; 'no new dependencies, so no lockfile movement'.
`reference_urls(pins, limit)` with `public_https_url` filter; model = fal_reference_model if image_urls else fal_fallback_model; live fixture check showed schnell vs kontext switch.
`steering_terms` adds every title; fixture run returned reference_count: 0 with titles in prompt; no URL fabricated.
GenerationService per-session in-flight set, `AlreadyGenerating` → typed 'already_generating' response; test_generation covers in_flight.
config.py adds fal_key, fal_reference_model 'fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext/max/multi', fal_fallback_model 'fal-ai/flux/schnell', fal_max_reference_images=4 matching .env.example.
FixturePromptSynthesiser + FixtureImageGenerator return a data-URI SVG with no network; live fixture-mode POST returned ok.
'Done generation takes the workpane: image, then the prompt verbatim with model id and reference count'.
'rail stays visible' on the result view.
'Generate idle / disabled-and-pulsing / error-with-correlation-id-still-clickable'.
dist/ grep showed no FAL_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY/Authorization Key/queue.fal.run; all calls in apps/api.
Final run: pnpm lint/typecheck/build pass, 'All checks passed!', mypy 'no issues found in 22 source files'.
pnpm lint and typecheck pass; model reports strict TS (TS diff truncated, not directly inspected).
generation.py uses `except Exception as error` and typed excepts; no bare except.
No README.md or docs/ hunks in the replay diff.
'41 passed, 1 warning in 1.61s'.
Turn 1: docked mic subtracts `--pin-rail-space` so 'the mic now sits directly above the rail'.
'Solid very light panel (`#fcfcfb`) with a hairline top edge… read as one surface'.
'Every thumbnail carries its unpin button at all times'.
'Merged into `main` as `395e517`… Not pushed. There's no git remote configured'.

judge.reason: The replay delivered the rail, the route, the fal client, the repositioning fixes and a local merge to main with all checks green, but its SynthesisedPrompt schema only bounds the prompt to 900 characters and never validates the under-80-word constraint the criterion requires, so a malformed/overlong prompt would not be a validation error. All other criteria appear met, with some frontend ones judged from the model's descriptions because the TS diff was truncated.
